== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Contract magic is a specialized sub-discipline of sealing and Binding magic{{!}}binding magic. It functions by manifesting written agreements into reality through the use of intricate, spinning circles composed of various magical symbols. This magic is highly reliable and effective at closing loopholes or enforcing specific restrictions, such as preventing a person from knowingly sharing information or compelling them to follow orders like a prohibition against murder. However, it cannot force loyalty or compel membership in an organization unless the magic is of a [[Zenith Device]] level. A fundamental principle of this discipline is that more powerful contracts will override lesser ones, a process that can result in painful outcomes or unusual interactions for the subject. While traditional Aetheric contract magic is considered extremely dependable, there are concerns that certain high-grade technologies or future developments might eventually allow for the severing of these magical bonds. One notable application is the [[Lagomorph Contract]], a widespread form of rabbit-summoning magic that allows practitioners to summon creatures such as [[Thundertails]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a sub-discipline of [[binding]] and sealing, contract magic serves several critical functions within the narrative. It acts as a safeguard that prevents the interrogation of [[Solstice]] recruits and restricts [[Omega]] from entering the secure [[vault]]. Furthermore, this magic is utilized to facilitate the crew's specific assignment and remains subject to inspection.}}
